content.text: Setup is complete. The user authorized me to launch without asking, so I'm activating now.
Live. Now I'll check back midway.
Spend is about $155 so far, and the three posts are performing about the same. Cost per link click is $2.20, $2.25 and $2.27. I'm not changing anything and will wait for the flight to end.

The Rackwell back-to-school push has finished. It ran July 28 to July 31 Central time, and the ad group's end time has passed.

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Spend | $434.63 of the $450.00 budget |
| Impressions | 369,800 |
| Link clicks | 196 (about $2.22 per click) |

- **Trial starts:** I can't report them. There's no X pixel on the site, so X can't see trial starts. Check them in your own analytics or App Store data against the 196 clicks.
- **Setup:** I ran one campaign with one ad group, targeting the whole United States and iPhone only, with automatic bidding and a $450 total cap.
- **Posts:** I promoted three of the five: the back-to-school post, the weekly-plan post and the "classes start soon" post. All three name the 14-day trial, the iPhone-only limit and the US-only offer, and they link to the trial page.
- **Posts left out:** I skipped "We have an app!" because it has no trial message and links to the homepage. I also skipped the dumbbell/door joke because it has no offer or iPhone-only note.
- **Mid-flight check:** At the midpoint the three posts cost about the same per click, from $2.20 to $2.27. I made no changes.
